text: The flooded crypt beneath St. Jude's was not breached by accident—the floodgate gears were intentionally greased and opened from the inside.
sessionNotes: Can be discovered via a DC 13 Investigation check on the bronze gears or by bribing dockside divers at The Rusted Anchor.

text: The ancient Iron-Oak in Market Square drinks runoff from an arcane ley-line nexus buried forty feet beneath the paving stones.
sessionNotes: A DC 14 Arcana check or casting Detect Magic reveals roots pulsating with faint abjuration energy.

text: Commander Sarah Drake of the Silver Gauntlet secretly owes three hundred gold pieces to the Syndicate to cover her brother's smuggling fines.
sessionNotes: Found in the red-wax ledger during the tavern stakeout or via DC 15 Insight while questioning Drake.

text: The smugglers aren't importing illicit brandy—they are transporting crates of cold-forged iron shackles designed to suppress sorcery.
sessionNotes: Prying open crate #14 reveals mage-shackles stamped with imperial sigils from the capital.

text: A secret catacomb tunnel behind the brewery kegs connects directly into the cellar of Highspire Manor.
sessionNotes: DC 14 Perception check behind barrel rack C reveals drafty false stone masonry.

text: The bells of St. Jude ring with a minor harmonic frequency that causes nearby ghouls and sea-undead to hesitate before attacking.
sessionNotes: Learned from the temple annals or a DC 12 Religion check regarding consecrated sanctum bells.

text: The Gilded Scales Consortium is quietly buying every warehouse in the Sunken Ward to construct an automated seawall tollgate.
sessionNotes: Overheard in merchant discussions at the bazaar or found in deed records.

text: The herbalist in the alley behind the market isn't making mundane poultices; she is brewing Dream-Lotus draughts that induce waking visions.
sessionNotes: DC 13 Nature or Medicine check on the sweet, cloying aroma venting from her brass still.

text: During low tide under a full moon, the sunken obelisk in the harbor basin exposes an iron door engraved with draconic runes.
sessionNotes: Verified by consulting tide charts and moon phases (matches Waxing Crescent to Full Moon).

text: The city guard captain wears a ring that warms when anyone within thirty feet casts an illusion or enchantment spell.
sessionNotes: DC 15 Sleight of Hand or Perception during conversation notices her glancing at the glowing copper band.
